blind.description: A stylized fantasy market stall built from a sturdy four-post wooden frame with a sloped orange and purple-striped cloth awning. The counter features stacked rolls of fabric in green, orange, and purple, alongside folded textiles in purple and cream, with one cloth draped over the front lip. An attached wooden crate on the side holds additional upright bolts of rolled fabric in green, purple, and cream. Surfaces are smooth and cleanly modeled in a cartoon/stylized art style.
blind.from_above: From directly above, it appears primarily as a square striped orange and maroon canopy stretched between four rounded wooden corner caps, with the side crate of rolled fabrics extending out to the bottom-left.
defects: A small white rectangular sliver/strip mesh artifact floats detached in midair behind the stall near the ground.
blind.height_vs_figure: Roughly three-quarters the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure (about 4.3 ft tall), and about 4.5 ft wide including the side crate.

notes: Tiny mesh sliver artifact near the ground behind the stall
